reason: Regulatory approval for ICICI Prudential AMC to acquire up to 9.95% of the bank provides a significant institutional vote of confidence and potential long-term capital support.
why_now: The exchange filing was released today, September 9, 2026.
source_headlines: AU Small Finance Bank Limited: We hereby inform that AU Small Finance Bank ( AU SFB ) has received RBI s letter dated September 8, 2026 according its approval to ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited ( I-Pru AMC ) (along with the schemes of ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, funds under AIF managed by I-Pru AMC, clients of PMS of I-Pru AMC) to acquire aggregate holding of up to 9.95% of the paid-up share capital or voting rights in AU SFB. The aforesaid approval granted by RBI is subject
